headline: VisorVolt and Prolifics sign a systems integrator partnership
title: VisorVolt and Prolifics Sign a Systems Integrator Partnership | VisorVolt News
desc: VisorVolt and Prolifics, a global systems integrator with 2,000+ experts, signed a partnership to deliver vision AI to clients in every industry.

title: VisorVolt Becomes a Zebra Technologies Registered ISV | VisorVolt News

summary: VisorVolt joined Zebra Technologies’ PartnerConnect program as a Registered ISV, in North America and Asia-Pacific.

headline: Healthfields counts cartons with VisorVolt on the cameras it already has
title: Healthfields Counts Cartons With VisorVolt on Its Existing Cameras | VisorVolt News
desc: Healthfields counts cartons at dispatch and on its packing line with VisorVolt, on its existing cameras and with no internet. Dated results v a person.
summary: On a dispatch day the system had never seen, the camera counted 102 cartons and a person counted 103. On a packing line, 141 and 141.

headline: Healthfields packing line: 141 cartons counted by camera, 141 by a person
title: Healthfields Packing Line: 141 Counted by Camera, 141 by a Person | VisorVolt
desc: Over 38 sampled windows on two days it had never seen (18-19 Nov 2026), VisorVolt counted 141 cartons on a Healthfields packing line. A person counted 141.
summary: Over 38 sampled windows on two days the system had never seen, the camera and a person agreed on the total.
